title: Their lunch
body:
I pulled a piece of sponge loose. The angelfish ate the bits that escaped my mouth.

With everyone watching, I took more care over the next bite. Nothing fell. They waited.

I had been tidying away their lunch.

Some underwater blue haze and softness do not obscure the central association. The head is partly among growth; no actual falling crumb is claimed visible.

Final sentence names that particular discovery rather than offering a general lesson.
